summary: Iteration 152 - Multi-Currency Line Items on City Ledger Invoices. Backend: 16/16 tests passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified - 41 currencies in dropdown, line items UI working, amount auto-calculation, line currency defaults to invoice currency.

tests: GET /api/currency-fx/rates returns 41 currencies (expanded from 10)
New currencies present: PLN, SEK, NOK, DKK, ZAR, SGD, HKD, MXN, BRL, NZD, SAR, QAR, KWD, CZK, HUF, RON, THB, CNY, KRW, IDR, MYR, PHP, VND
KWD rate > 1 GBP (2.58) - correctly handles rates above 1
_get_rate_map fills missing codes from SEED_RATES_TO_GBP without duplicating existing rows
GET /api/currency-fx/settings returns 41+ available_codes
POST /api/city-ledger/invoices accepts lines: [{description, amount, currency, quantity}]
When lines provided, server ignores posted amount and computes from line totals
Each line has line_total_native (amount × quantity in line currency)
Each line has line_total_invoice_cur (converted to invoice currency)
Invoice in GBP with EUR/USD/GBP lines correctly computes total ~£595
100 KWD @ 2.58 = £258 (rate > 1 handled correctly)
Cross-currency conversion via base works (EUR to USD)
GET /api/city-ledger/invoices/{id}/pdf returns valid PDF
PDF starts with %PDF magic bytes
Line items table rendered in PDF when lines array is non-empty
Invoice currency dropdown (ledger-inv-currency) contains 41 options
All new currencies present: PLN, SEK, NOK, KWD, SGD, HKD verified
ledger-add-line button adds new row with description/qty/rate/currency
Line currency dropdown also contains 41 options
Line currency defaults to currently selected invoice currency
Amount field becomes disabled and labelled 'Amount (auto from lines)' when lines exist
Create Invoice saves successfully with multi-currency lines
Invoice created toast appears
New invoice appears in list with correct converted amount
Invoice without lines still works (uses flat amount)
City ledger companies CRUD still works
City ledger invoices CRUD still works
AR aging endpoint still works
Portfolio summary endpoint still works

critical_code_review_comments: All 41 currencies correctly seeded with realistic FX rates
Multi-currency line items roll up correctly to invoice currency
Line currency correctly defaults to invoice currency when added
Amount field properly disabled when lines exist
PDF generation includes line items table
Backward compatibility maintained for invoices without lines
seed_data_creation: Test companies and invoices created and cleaned up during testing. FX rates auto-seeded on first API call (41 currencies).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 152 extended multi-currency feature with 41 ISO currencies and multi-currency line items on City Ledger invoices. Backend: 16 tests covering currency rates (41 codes), line item creation, FX conversion (including KWD rate > 1), PDF generation. Frontend: Currency dropdown has 41 options, line items UI works correctly, line currency defaults to invoice currency, amount auto-calculates from lines. All features working end-to-end.
